brief: A refined heritage-learning symbol: an open warm-parchment book whose central page fold rises into a single small stylized Gulf wind-tower/barjeel in sandstone, with four clearly cut ventilation openings and a restrained bronze rim. Book and heritage architecture are physically integrated into one strong silhouette. The purpose is learning history through source-backed reading, not an archaeological fragment or museum seal. Sandstone #CBA16A, parchment #F0E1C6 and bronze #805C3C. No invented inscriptions, emblems, Arabic lettering, flags or generic mosque dome.

Centered, longest extent around 72% of canvas with entirely transparent margins. Soft studio illumination, subtle depth, no ground plane shadow or debris. The picture must communicate the app's function directly.
